text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—Was it because she wasn't strong enough? 
Watching both her mentor and his father 
lose their strength, Nakayama Festa is 
left utterly crushed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli explains. The pain of 
losing hope is terrifying. Your fighting 
spirit turns to ashes, leaving you to be 
trampled underfoot by the strong.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—However, Nakayama Festa won't give up. 
Today is the last chance to show them 
hope. Rousing her spirits, she resolves to 
deliver great results.
